description: Yandex Mobile Ads SDK (Yandex Advertising Network), Maven com.yandex.android:mobileads. The 8.x release renamed MobileAds to YandexAds and MobileAdsInitializeProvider to YandexAdsInitializeProvider, replaced the *RequestConfiguration load API with loadAd(AdRequest, listener), and added Kotlin suspend overloads of loadAd returning Object.

obfuscation.internal_prefix: yads.* with 1-5 char names (e.g. yads.tt5) in 7.x/8.x; com.yandex.mobile.ads.impl.* in 5.x/6.x. Names change on every release

protected_patterns.reason: 8.x Kotlin suspend overloads of loadAd/loadAds. They return InterstitialAdLoadResult, NativeAdLoadResult and similar as Object. A return-null stub hands app code a null non-null sealed result, which causes an NPE or a NoWhenBranchMatchedException. They use a separate internal path, not the callback overload. Stub only the explicit void signatures listed in ad_operations
Static String getter on YandexAds/MobileAds that apps log or compare. Null can cause an NPE
8.x YandexAds returns a singleton object that app code calls methods on
BannerAdView returns a VideoController that apps attach listeners to. Null causes an NPE
Static factories (8.x sticky/inline/fixed/closableSticky; 6.x-7.x *Size; 5.x AdSize.stickySize/flexibleSize) whose result goes to BannerAdView.setAdSize. Null can cause an NPE in app or SDK code
Returns an AdRequest that app code passes to load methods. Null can crash before the stubbed load is reached
